meta.name: One Pace – Post-Enies Lobby
meta.description:
The Straw Hats return to Water Seven after the ordeal at Enies Lobby. While there, they are met by a familial vice admiral, and they await news of their new ship.

Arc 20 din One Pace: 6 episoade, capitole 431–441. Acoperă episoadele One Piece 313–325. Subtitrare în română.

videos.title: 01. Fist of Love
videos.overview: Two days later in Water Seven, Franky hears that the item he purchased with the Straw Hats' stolen money has arrived. While the pirates recover from the events at Enies Lobby, a Marine vice admiral arrives to pay Luffy an unexpected visit.

videos.title: 02. The Name of That Sea
videos.overview: Garp tells Luffy that he's not going to arrest him or his crew, giving Luffy a moment to sit down and catch up with Koby and Helmeppo. As the old friends reminisce about how they met, however, something big is stirring in the New World. Not even the Marines' best can keep "Red-Haired" Shanks from meeting Whitebeard, arriving with his crew, some booze, and a very important request.

videos.title: 03. You Have My Sympathies
videos.overview: "The edition of the daily newspaper covering the Enies Lobby incident finally releases, and with it some "bad" news for the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, as Luffy and the gang get some much-needed rest, Franky gets some unexpected help while working on their new ship."

videos.title: 04. Briefs from Franky House
videos.overview: The Straw Hats have barely had time to marvel at their new bounties when a new surprise awaits them: the unveiling of their magnificent new ship. The next step is bringing a shipwright into their ranks, and there is only one man for the job.

videos.title: 05. The Astonishing Thousand Sunny and Usopp's Tearful Apology!
videos.overview: The Straw Hats set sail, but Usopp is conspicuously missing. Zoro soberly reminds Luffy that Usopp's return should not be granted so casually. More immediately, the pirates need to avoid Garp’s barrage of cannon balls!

videos.title: 06. The Circling Bounties and The Duel on Banaro Island!
videos.overview: The Straw Hats’ new wanted posters begin circulating around the world, but three days earlier, Blackbeard began plotting their pursuit. However, one obstacle stood in his way; Ace had finally caught up to his estranged crewmate!
